title: Signed and unsigned array sorting
adaptation: Change element width/signed load, comparison condition, and length.

title: Bounded recurrence into an array
adaptation: Change the seed block and the one recurrence-rule block; keep the array ABI.

title: Matrix and graph traversal
adaptation: Keep row-major addressing; replace only neighbor/edge acceptance and termination policy.

title: Frequency-count comparison
adaptation: Choose frequency counters for a small value range or used markers for general values.

title: Fixed-point multiply and recurrence
adaptation: Change Q format and coefficients; recalculate the post-SMULL shift.

title: Nested loops with preserved outer state
adaptation: Keep outer state in preserved registers and reset the inner index at each outer iteration.

title: Balanced early exit from inner search
adaptation: Branch to one named inner-loop exit; do not bypass stack restoration.

title: Signed and unsigned byte arrays
adaptation: Use LDRB for unsigned bytes or LDRSB for signed bytes; index scale is one.

title: Word-array traversal
adaptation: Use LSL #2 scaled addressing and pass element count, not byte count.

title: Row-major matrix addressing
adaptation: Compute row * columns + column, then apply the element-size or packed-bit transform.

title: Four-register argument contract
adaptation: Move long-lived R0-R3 pointers into preserved registers before reusing argument registers.

title: Fifth and later arguments
adaptation: Capture the caller's original SP before PUSH and calculate offsets from that value.

title: Non-leaf prologue and epilogue
adaptation: Save LR before the first BL and save an even total number of registers.

title: APSR flag contract
adaptation: Use the S-suffixed arithmetic instruction that naturally creates the required flags.

title: SVC immediate decoding
adaptation: Decode the byte at stacked PC-2 and write return values into the stacked frame.

title: MSP/PSP exception-frame selection
adaptation: Test EXC_RETURN bit 2 before selecting MSP or PSP; preserve EXC_RETURN in LR.

title: Timer setup and ownership
adaptation: Assign each timer/vector once and keep the callback bounded.

title: GPIO event capture
adaptation: Publish an event in the callback and consume it once in foreground.

title: Joystick event state machine
adaptation: Change the transition table and display policy, not the debounce/event plumbing.

title: ADC sample conversion
adaptation: Normalize the 12-bit sample once, then pass the value to a small policy function.

title: DAC table streaming
adaptation: Change sample table and period; keep the ISR index bounded and wrap explicitly.

title: ISR-to-foreground event loop
adaptation: Callbacks only set bits/data; the foreground loop owns algorithm calls and display changes.

title: Deterministic debounce
adaptation: Change confirmation ticks in configuration; retain press and release edges.

title: Periodic match scheduling
adaptation: Change the millisecond period and timer ID in the configuration call.

title: Free-running timer seed
adaptation: Use the counter as a seed/capture and do not enable the match interrupt unless required.

title: Register preservation and stack safety
adaptation: Preserve R4-R11, save LR before BL, and push an even register count.

title: Atomic ISR event handoff
adaptation: Make shared events volatile/atomic through the kit API and take them once in foreground.

title: Exclusive interrupt-vector ownership
adaptation: Select exactly one owner per IRQ handler and clear only that peripheral's pending source.
